mispricing.label: Fundamental mispricing
mispricing.short: Fair value from fundamentals vs market value
mispricing.cite: Bartram & Grinblatt (2018), Agnostic Fundamental Analysis Works, Journal of Financial Economics

resid_mom.label: Residual momentum
resid_mom.short: 12-1 month return after removing market, size and value exposure
resid_mom.cite: Blitz, Huij & Martens (2011), Residual Momentum, Journal of Empirical Finance
resid_mom.reason: t = 0.6; sign differs before and after 2011

insider_buying.label: Opportunistic insider buying
insider_buying.short: More opportunistic insiders buying than selling over 6 months (routine traders excluded); the bearish side is net opportunistic selling
insider_buying.cite: Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski (2012), Decoding Inside Information, Journal of Finance

earnings_reaction.label: Earnings reaction
earnings_reaction.short: Market-adjusted 3-day return around the latest earnings release
earnings_reaction.cite: Chan, Jegadeesh & Lakonishok (1996), Momentum Strategies, Journal of Finance

abnormal_volume.label: Abnormal volume
abnormal_volume.short: Last week's trading volume vs the prior 50 days
abnormal_volume.cite: Gervais, Kaniel & Mingelgrin (2001), The High-Volume Return Premium, Journal of Finance
abnormal_volume.reason: t = -0.8; sign differs before and after 2011

convergence_rule: Counts only indicators whose flagged names beat the universe before costs over the full backtest.

etf_lead.label: Sector ETF residual momentum
etf_lead.short: Sector and industry ETFs whose past-year return, net of market, size and value, ranks highest
etf_lead.cite: Blitz, Huij & Martens (2011), Residual Momentum, Journal of Empirical Finance; Moskowitz & Grinblatt (1999)
